newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar hovering narrowly in early Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Dollar hovering narrowly in early Tokyo.

text.p: 0006 GMT -- *Dollar moving narrowly against yen and mark in early Tokyo amid dearth of fresh factors.
*Offers by exporters and profit-talking seen above 115.00 yen, although stop-loss buying expected at 115.30 yen.
*Even if the stop-loss buying triggered, further selling likely to cap dollar's rise at around 115.50 yen, dealers said.

*Focus on dollar/mark movement ahead of EU summit starting later in day, with expectations of a weak and broad euro seen supporting dollar vs mark. "Focus for today and Tuesday will be centred on dollar/mark related to the summit," said a dealer.
